known_issues.issue: Station offline / communication loss with cloud
known_issues.probable_cause: Weak 4G signal near forecourt canopy; SIM data session drops

known_issues.issue: Charger module overcurrent fault on slot 7

known_issues.probable_cause: Ambient above 40°C and clogged intake filter

incident_history.symptoms: Charging paused on 5 slots, cabinet temperature 58°C, swap queue building up
incident_history.root_cause: Intake air filter clogged with dust; exhaust fan 2 running at 40% RPM
incident_history.resolution: Cleaned and replaced intake filter, replaced exhaust fan 2, verified cabinet temperature dropped to 41°C within 30 minutes

incident_history.symptoms: Station showing offline on dashboard for 2 hours; swaps working locally but not synced
incident_history.root_cause: SIM data session stuck after network tower maintenance
incident_history.resolution: Remote modem reboot failed; on-site power cycle of modem restored connectivity. Offline transactions synced automatically

incident_history.symptoms: Slot 7 shows red LED, batteries inserted in slot 7 not charging
incident_history.root_cause: Charger module CM-07 output MOSFET failure
incident_history.resolution: Slot 7 disabled remotely, charger module CM-07 replaced with spare (S/N CM15-88231), slot re-enabled after test charge
